prompt: Write a one-star review of the Statue of Liberty from a reviewer who is upset that you have to take a boat.
response:
★☆☆☆☆

I was shocked to learn the Statue of Liberty is on an island. An island! That means you have to take a boat just to see it up close. No one warned me that visiting one of America’s most famous landmarks would involve basic geography.

The statue itself was fine, I guess, but the whole “ferry” situation ruined the experience. You have to wait in line, board a boat, ride across water, and then—get this—take the boat back. Extremely inconvenient for anyone who expected the Statue of Liberty to be located somewhere more practical, like a parking lot.

One star for being tall. Would not recommend unless they build a bridge or move it.
